description.value: Tableau Bar Bistro is an award-winning French bistro in Vancouver's Coal Harbour neighbourhood, blending classic French fare with West Coast flavours in a relaxed, inviting atmosphere. The restaurant features main dining, bar, patio seating, and two private dining rooms for larger gatherings. Walk-ins are always welcome, making it an accessible option for cyclists passing through Coal Harbour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM address (1181 Melville Street, Vancouver, BC V6E 0A3) and phone (604.639.8692). The menu page explicitly lists 'TAKE OUT' as a dedicated menu category, confirming takeout availability. No cycling-specific amenities—bike parking, water refill, bike rack, or Wi-Fi—are mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags, leaving all required WWC criteria unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM tag outdoor_seating=no conflicts with website text referencing 'on the patio', suggesting the OSM tag may be outdated.
OSM opening_hours check_date is 2022-09-24; current hours may differ from OSM-recorded hours.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Tableau is a legitimate, active full-service restaurant in a cyclist-friendly part of Vancouver, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the available evidence; on-site verification would resolve this.

wow_evidence: award-winning French bistro in Vancouver's Coal Harbour
